drafts.subject: Invoice MP-7313 (PO 4500012167) - credit note request for 20 pallets
drafts.body:
Hello,

Thank you for invoice MP-7313 dated 22 September 2026 against our purchase order 4500012167, totalling $7,920.00 including GST.

On line 1 (Timber pallet 1165x1165 standard), the invoice bills 300 ea. Our receiving records show 280 ea were accepted, as 20 pallets were rejected at receipt because of broken bearers. This leaves a difference of 20 ea, or $480.00 excluding GST.

Could you please issue a credit note for the 20 pallets, referencing invoice MP-7313? Once we have received it, we will process payment for the 280 pallets received.

If you would like to arrange collection of the rejected pallets, or if you believe our records are incorrect, please let us know and we will look into it promptly.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable, Corio Packaging
